messages:
emma_sales: On a call with MediSys"); demo script spiked to ~700 qps and their POC route started returning 503/502. Help?

rory_se: Which model/key/region? Any example req id?

emma_sales: hosted trial key, route pinned to rdx-large-v1, region=us-east-1. Sample header: X-Req-Id: ms-91a2. Errors: '503 Service Unavailable (Throttle)' and intermittent '502 Bad Gateway'. Customer watching.

nina_oncall: seeing alerts: queue depth jumped, autoscaler logged several 429s from provider while launching instances. Pulling logs.

infra_bot: alert: autoscale.retry_rate_high; queued_requests=1100; active_nodes=3; desired_nodes=8.

jake_billing: flagged & standing by for any potential trial overages.

nina_oncall: runtime snippet for req ms-91a2:

```
2026-03-24T09:15:02Z [autoscaler] INFO desired=8 current=3
2026-03-24T09:15:02Z [autoscaler] ERROR provider-api 429 Too Many Requests
2026-03-24T09:15:03Z [autoscaler] WARN retrying launch (attempt=5)
2026-03-24T09:15:04Z [router] ERROR returning 503 to client req=ms-91a2
```

emma_sales: customer is asking for immediate mitigation and an explanation for their security/comms packet.

rory_se: Short-term: 1) flip route fallback to a quantized smaller model `rdx-medium-q` 2) allocate 2 warm burst nodes for demo 3) ask the load generator to throttle to 250 qps until stable. Those combined should stop 5xxs within ~30s.

ops-bot: Request: `opsctl burst allocate --name medipoc --nodes 2` queued.

nina_oncall: I'll flip fallback if someone confirms allocation is ok. @jake_billing ok to waive trial overage for this demo?

jake_billing: waive for this single demo; I'll create a credit ticket and CC sales.

ops-bot: burst allocation job 4572 accepted (cloud request id cb-77).

rory_se: changing route: `POST /routes/medisys {"fallback_model":"rdx-medium-q","max_qps":500}` executed.

emma_sales: asking customer to throttle to 200 qps now.

emma_sales: update: error rate dropped to ~0.5% after 20s. Latency median improved. Customer resumed demo. :relieved:

jake_billing: credit ticket created: BILL-3341. Note: fallback model reduces compute cost; burst nodes are covered by credit for this session.

nina_oncall: root cause summary for postmortem: our autoscaler aggressively retried provider launches without sufficient backoff+jitter; provider returned 429s leading to delayed scale and router saturated -> 5xxs. Action items: A) implement exponential backoff with capped retries + jitter B) add a 'demo prewarm' API for Sales to reserve a small warm pool C) surface provider-rate-limit metric in dashboard. Filed INF-2055 assigned to @rory_se.

rory_se: I'll open the PR for backoff changes and link in INF-2055. Also adding a short runbook for Sales: always declare expected peak QPS and schedule prewarm 15m prior.

emma_sales: can someone draft a one-paragraph customer-friendly blurb I can include in the security/comms doc?

jake_billing: suggested blurb: "We observed transient 5xx responses during your demo because our autoscaler experienced provider-side rate limits when provisioning additional inference instances. To restore service we routed traffic to a lighter-weight model and allocated temporary burst capacity. Engineering has a ticket to harden autoscaler retries and we'll prewarm capacity for future demos."

emma_sales: perfect, sending that now. Thanks all.

infra_bot: INF-2055 created: 'provider-rate-limit -> autoscale lag during demo bursts' assigned to rory_se; priority=P2.

nina_oncall: closing this thread unless any regressions reported.
